verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, covered by its SLA, and offers an agent skill for migrating client code to the latest major version. Official InstantSearch UI libraries (vanilla JS, React) round this out, and community users corroborate easy SDK-based builds (React InstantSearch, a Node import script). Missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK reference or installation docs in the evidence, as the client list is a single-line mention.
